scripts.zen-publish: pnpm build && zen publish && pnpm run lua-bundle && cd lua-bundle && zen publish && cd ../
scripts.build: pnpm shx rm -rf out && pnpm rbxtsc --type=package
scripts.build-old: pnpm shx rm -rf out && pnpm rbxtsc --type=package && darklua process out out -c darklua-bundler.json5
scripts.lua-bundle: darklua process core-lua.lua lua-bundle/out/init.lua -c darklua-bundler.json5 && pnpm shx cp package.json lua-bundle/package.json && cd lua-bundle && npm pkg set name=@mekstuff-rbxts/core-lua && npm pkg delete scripts dependencies peerDependencies devDependencies && cd ../
